prompts.name: bench
prompts.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Reference image is the exact existing game character, not a pose guide. Make a production sprite sheet of THIS SAME Ignacio Mustacho: brown-skinned slender adult, huge black moustache, full straight black fringe with swept-up side hair wings, large expressive eyes, green jersey with ivory 00 and ivory piping, green shorts, ivory sneakers. Match face, body proportions, outfit, detailed sculpted illustration and lighting precisely. Genuine transparent background, no ground, no shadow, no text, no ball, no hoop, no extra objects. EXACTLY 12 full-body sequential animation frames in THREE columns and FOUR rows, chronological row-major order. Equal cell dimensions, same camera and scale, constant foot baseline, generous transparent margins so no two figures or their raised hands touch neighboring cells. Each frame is a distinct smoothly drawn in-between, no motion trails, no ghost limbs. All movement stays inside each cell. Frames 1 and 12 use same relaxed upright ready pose with feet shoulder-width apart. Comedy celebration called Bench Legend: Ignacio earnestly POLISHES AN INVISIBLE BENCH at his side with his bare hand, then proudly inspects the nonexistent seat. No bench or cloth is drawn. 1 ready, 2 turn torso slightly to viewer right, 3 bend knees a little, 4 reach right palm toward an imaginary seat at hip height to viewer right, 5 sweep palm across empty horizontal space, 6 sweep back, 7 short second polishing sweep, 8 inspect empty palm with serious eyebrow, 9 tiny approving nod, 10 straighten, 11 return ready, 12 ready. Hand must be outside the legs, this is a comic sideways seat-wiping pantomime, not dribbling. No real furniture or props.

prompts.name: bench-framing-final
prompts.prompt: Edit target: this exact 12-frame Bench Legend sprite atlas. Preserve all twelve poses in their chronological 3-column 4-row arrangement, face identity, moustache, hairstyle, uniform, lighting and transparent background. Correct production framing ONLY: all figures must be slightly smaller within their individual equal cells, with at least 25 transparent pixels between any hand/hair/shoe and every cell edge. Especially row 1 column 3: the extended hand and all fingertips on viewer right must be fully visible and reconstructed, not cut by the canvas edge. Every figure keeps a common scale and foot baseline within its cell. Do not change the bench-polishing pantomime, do not add furniture, ball, text, props, background or shadows. True alpha transparency.
